exposure: Hormone replacement cycle frozen-thawed embryo transfer (HRC-FET)
cohort: 4636 singleton and 544 twin live births after FET
finding: HRC-FET was associated with the highest maternal risks of hypertensive disorders compared to NC-FET and SC-FET.
